content.short: Grapes offers decentralized social networking on Solana and DAO tooling.
content.description: Grapes serves as a community booster, manager, and content creator, providing marketing and branding services, development support, and guidance for setting up DAOs. Its offerings are organized into two packages: New NFT Project and New Defi Project. The Defi package includes event planning and Discord moderation, while the NFT package covers mint analysis, art/story/trait consulting, and additional related services to support project teams from concept to launch.
